description: One Amazon seller connection. A single-seller bench has exactly one, named 'default'; a multi-tenant bench has one per seller. Holds the OAuth refresh token and region.

fields.description: Stable id used by callers and by the OAuth callback. A bench upgraded from the single-connection version keeps its one connection as 'default'.
fields.label: Connection ID

fields.description: Human-readable name, e.g. the seller or brand.
fields.label: Label

fields.description: Used when a caller names no connection. A bench with exactly one connection does not need this set.
fields.label: Default Connection

fields.description: Set by whichever app created this connection, so a multi-tenant bench can tell its own rows from ones made by hand.
fields.label: Created By App

fields.description: Draft apps append version=beta to the consent URL.
fields.label: App Status

fields.description: Encrypted at rest. Set by the OAuth callback; never shown to the client.
fields.label: Refresh Token

fields.description: One brand per line. Amazon grants a GTIN exemption per brand (and sometimes per product type) in Seller Central; listing a brand here says that grant exists, so a new ASIN under it can be created without a barcode. Nothing here is verified with Amazon — a brand named without the grant is rejected at submission.
fields.label: GTIN-Exempt Brands

fields.description: Where synced Seller Central orders land. Orders are created as Sales Orders directly.
fields.label: Orders

fields.description: Every Amazon order books against this customer. Buyer identity is a restricted SP-API endpoint, so there is no real buyer to create a Customer from; the buyer is traceable from the Amazon Order ID.
fields.label: Default Customer

fields.description: Defaults to the global default company when unset.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: Must be a leaf (non-Group) warehouse, or stock documents raised from these orders will fail.
fields.label: Default Warehouse

fields.description: Order lines whose SellerSKU isn't linked to a catalog Item book against this. Leave blank to auto-create a non-stock "Amazon Unmapped Item" placeholder on first use. The real SKU is kept on each order line.
fields.label: Unmapped SKU Item

fields.description: How far back the first sync reaches. Leave blank to start from 1 day ago. Only used until the watermark below is set — to re-read an older range afterwards, use Backfill Orders on the Sales Order list.
fields.label: Sync Orders From

fields.description: Watermark for the scheduled poll. Advances only after a complete run; clear it to force a re-read.
fields.label: Last Orders Sync At

module: Alaiy Os Connector Amazon Sp Api
name: Amazon Connection
